prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 3.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1280
Claimant:
Kathryn Edwards
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
May 30, 2024
First notice of loss came in from the policyholder's side after a sideswipe that happened while changing lanes. The
insured reported the other vehicle drifted into their lane as they signaled to move over, and the claim was opened for
bodily injury and property damage.
June 5, 2024
The driver is named on the policy and the coverage was in force at the time of loss. Nothing in the policy history
suggests the vehicle damage predates the coverage start.
June 26, 2024
Claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact is being routed through the attorney's office. A letter of
representation has been placed in the file.
July 12, 2024
Police report reviewed. Responding officers recorded the claimant as an occupnat of the vehicle at the scene, and the
report is consistent with the account given to us so far.
July 29, 2024
Photos of the vehicles were obtained from the insured and the other driver. The damage along the right side of the
insured vehicle lines up with the described contact point, and the other vehicle's left-side damage is consistent with it.
July 31, 2024
Statements taken from two independent witnesses both describe the other vehicle moving into the adjacent lane
during the lane change. Each witness account matches the others on sequence and position.
September 30, 2024
Claimant reported a concussion with headache, dizziness, and light sensitivity. The reported injury is plausible for a
clolision of this type, and no prior injury to the head or neck is known from the records requested so far.
October 6, 2024
The claimant has given the same account of the collision in each conversation, including the initial call, the recorded
interview, and follow-up with counsel. Details of sequence and vehicle positions have not changed.
October 8, 2024
A few small scratches were noted on the insured vehicle's rear quarter panel in the photos. These may be older than
this crash, and a separate estimate line is being prepared to address them.
October 25, 2024
Treatment records show a usual course of care, beginning with evaluation and followed by physical therapy and
periodic checks. Symptoms have improved steadily and the frequency of visits has tapered as the claimant
recovered.
November 2, 2024
Medical bills and wage documentation have been requested through counsel. Reserve has been reviewed against
the treatment timeline and the current estimates for both vehicles.
November 8, 2024
File is pending receipt of the outstanding records and the final repair estimate. Next review is set for after counsel
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
